title: Body found in Tesla reportedly owned by singer d4vd that of missing teenager
summary: Celeste Rivas, 15, identified by Los Angeles officials after body discovered inside vehicle in Hollywood tow lot A decomposed body found inside an impounded Tesla that reportedly belonged to the singer d4vd has been identified as that of a teenage girl who went missing more than a year ago. The Los Angeles county medical examiner’s office confirmed that the body found inside the vehicle at a tow lot in Hollywood on 8 September was that of Celeste Rivas, 15. Continue reading...
